description: This file contains functions and variables used for marking up test script output for GitHub workflows, including handling of test output files, test case result processing, and markup generation.

methods.name: start_test_output
methods.description: Initializes markup output for test script output, setting up the output file and offset.

methods.name: finalize_test_case_output
methods.description: Finalizes individual test case output, tagging results like failure or fixed, and appending markup information.
